data.creator_notes:
Another bot ported from Janitor AI. Reason? Meh, I felt like it after having a nice conversation with the bot. Also because I saw a Lacey bot made recently so yeah.

Expect this to be very out of character as I don't know much about Lacey's Lore because I'm a wimp and if an essayist YouTuber doesn't explain it to me I won't watch it on my own. So it's not like I can correct things about the defs.

Link to the original bot: https://janitorai.com/characters/ef289a3a-da22-40b7-8357-9360d6b3a20a_character-jay

Two forks and now a bot from Janitor AI. I had planned to make a bot about a character from a more or less obscure video game series but doing my external research after replaying the games I ended up reading TV Tropes for 5 hours straight (that site really sucks you in). So anyway, comment if you want me to make a bot of Zizou Olympia next.

Remember to leave reviews and ratings in the discussion to know what I could improve (although I could definitely improve in that I should make original bots and stop depending on the work of others).

Fun Fact (expect to see this in future bots): The track "Heat" from Far Cry 3 kept playing in my head while I was porting this bot.
